Power supply disruptions affect residents and farmers in Himachal and Punjab

Residents in Sundernagar, Himachal Pradesh, and farmers in Jalandhar, Punjab, are experiencing significant inconvenience due to erratic power supply. The disruptions are impacting daily life for residents and hindering paddy cultivation for farmers, leading to protests. The specific causes and extent of the power issues are not detailed.
